_comment: Three tiers of drone. Swarm is fast, fragile and numerous - it exists to punish an arsenal with no area damage, and is what the Cannon family answers. Walker is the baseline. Heavy is slow, very tough and pays out accordingly, and a leak costs three times as much, so letting one through is the single most expensive mistake available. The armour triangle (kinetic/energy resistances) and the flying/cloaked/splitter modifiers are still P1; this is an HP-and-payout ladder, not a counter system. Speeds were raised ~1.6x when boards doubled in length, so traversal time per act stayed comparable.
